**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — § 12.4 non-compete on Customer**

§ 12.4 imposes on us a non-compete that is (i) 24 months post-term, (ii) worldwide, (iii) undefined in scope ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), and (iv) expressly extends to *acquiring* such products — i.e. no carve-out for internal development or M&A. That is walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE and fails the fallback on every material term.

It also flatly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that we have made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

**Redline (validated, preferred position):** delete § 12.4 in full, with a comment noting we cannot restrict our business and offering the narrowed fallback (single named competing product, term only, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) if Copperleaf needs protection.
